resources.string: Thumela izilinganiso ezintsha njenge-JSON kuseva yakho. Shiya i-URL ingenalutho ukuze uvale ukudlulisela. Sebenzisa i-HTTPS ukuvikela izilinganiso nemininingwane yokungena.

Uma umlando wasendaweni uvaliwe, izilinganiso ezintsha zihlala kuphela emgqeni wesikhashana wokulayisha kuze kube iseva iyazamukela. Umlando okhona uyagcinwa. Ukuthekelisa ku-Health Connect kudinga umlando wasendaweni.
Faka i-URL ye-HTTP(S) evumelekile nenani le-Authorization elisemgqeni owodwa.
Okunye ukulayisha akukamukelwa. Kuzozanywa futhi ngokuzenzakalelayo.
Izilinganiso ezisemgqeni zihlala zabelwe iseva yazo yokuqala. Ukushintsha i-URL kumisa okwesikhashana ukulayisha kuseva yangaphambilini.

Ukudlulisela nge-HTTP kuyazikhethela futhi kuvaliwe ekuqaleni. Uma kuvuliwe, izilinganiso ezintsha zithunyelwa kuseva oyishoyo. Ukulayisha okulindile kugcinwa ngasese kuze kwamukelwe. Ukudlulisela ngaphandle komlando wasendaweni akufaki izilinganiso emlandweni wasendaweni noma ku-Health Connect. Idatha eyayilondoloziwe iyagcinwa.
Izilungiselelo zokudlulisela azikwazanga ukulondolozwa. Sicela uzame futhi.
